mapper.select: SELECT flt03_account_id AS account_id , TO_CHAR(apr01_effect_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS appr_effect_date , (select f_cdnm('FloorTrCheckCycle', flt02_check_cycle, flt02_company_id, f_sysdate()) from flt02_emp where flt02_person_id = flt03_person_id and flt02_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) order by flt02_start_date DESC limit 1) AS check_cycle_name , emp00_kor_nm AS person_name , emp00_org_code_nm AS org_name , sys15_corp_nm AS corp_name , TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) AS account_no_dec , flt03_account_nm AS account_name , f_cdnm('FamilyRelateCode', flt03_family_relate_cd, flt03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS family_relate_name FROM flt03_account INNER JOIN getPerson(#{companyId}, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) ON emp00_person_id = flt03_person_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp00_person_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(t.emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans t WHERE t.emp03_person_id = emp00_person_id AND t.emp03_trans_date < CAST(#{startDate} AS date)) LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = flt03_corp_id AND sys15_company_id = flt03_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON flt03_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE flt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_cd = ( CASE #{transCode} WHEN '100' THEN ( CASE WHEN emp03_trans_cd <= '899' /** 퇴직(900)만 제외한다. (겸직자 재직자로 인식)-*/ THEN emp03_trans_cd ELSE #{transCode} END) WHEN '900' THEN '900' WHEN '800' THEN '800' ELSE emp03_trans_cd END) AND apr01_effect_date IS NOT NULL AND apr01_effect_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY emp00_kor_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc, apr01_effect_date DESC
mapper.sql:
WITH emp AS ( SELECT * , COALESCE(f_get_floorTrCheck('1', emp01_company_id, emp01_person_id, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), false),0) as emp01_year_invest_limit , COALESCE(f_get_floorTrCheck('2', emp01_company_id, emp01_person_id, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), false),0) as emp01_total_invest_amt , COALESCE(f_get_floorTrCheck('3', emp01_company_id, emp01_person_id, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), false),0) as emp01_turnover_rate , CASE WHEN flt02_check_cycle = '1' THEN f_get_quarter_date(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date),'1') + 1 -- 분기초일 ELSE DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(#{stdDate} AS date))::date -- 월초일 END as emp01_tr_start_date , CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) as emp01_tr_close_date , CASE WHEN flt02_check_cycle = '1' THEN f_get_quarter_date(f_today(),'1') -- 전분기말 ELSE DATE_TRUNC('month', f_today())::date -1 -- 전월말 END as rpt_std_date , f_cdnm('FloorTrCheckCycle', flt02_check_cycle, emp01_company_id, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) as check_cycle_nm , COALESCE(account_cnt, 0)||'건' as account_cnt_str , CASE WHEN COALESCE(flt04_person_id,0) = 0 THEN '' ELSE '○' END as oath_yn_nm , CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flt07_family_consent INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_parent_id = flt07_family_consent_id WHERE flt07_person_id = emp01_person_id ) = 0 THEN '' ELSE '○' END as family_yn_nm , ( SELECT MAX(apr01_effect_date) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT apr01_appr.* FROM flt10_tr INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = flt10_appr_id WHERE flt10_company_id = emp01_company_id AND flt10_person_id = emp01_person_id AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('40','99') AND apr01_effect_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) UNION SELECT * FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_company_id = emp01_company_id AND apr01_reg_emp_id = emp01_person_id AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('40','99') AND apr01_effect_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) AND apr01_class_tree_id IN ( SELECT dcr30_class_tree_id FROM dcr30_link WHERE dcr30_company_id = apr01_company_id AND dcr30_link_cd = 'A09' ) /* (A09:자기매매 실거래 보고) */ ) apr ) AS rcnt_report_date FROM ------------------------------------------------------------------------ emp01_person INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON ( emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date < CAST(#{startDate} AS date) ) ) INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM org01_code INNER JOIN org02_info ON ( org02_code_id = org01_code_id AND org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info WHERE org02_code_id = org01_code_id AND org02_mod_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ) ) WHERE org01_company_id = #{companyId} ) org ON org01_code_id = emp03_org_code_id ------------------------------------------------------------------------ LEFT OUTER JOIN flt01_company_std ON ( flt01_company_id = emp01_company_id AND flt01_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt01_start_date) FROM flt01_company_std WHERE flt01_company_id = emp01_company_id AND flt01_start_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN flt02_emp ON ( flt02_person_id = emp01_person_id AND flt02_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt02_start_date) FROM flt02_emp WHERE flt02_person_id = emp01_person_id AND flt02_start_date <= GREATEST(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date), COALESCE(flt01_rpt_start_date,'1900-01-01')) ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT flt03_person_id, COUNT(*) account_cnt FROM flt03_account INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = flt03_appr_id WHERE flt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('40','99') GROUP BY flt03_person_id ) flt03 ON flt03_person_id = emp01_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT flt04_person_id, COUNT(*) oath_cnt FROM flt04_oath INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = flt04_appr_id WHERE flt04_company_id = #{companyId} AND apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('40','99') GROUP BY flt04_person_id ) flt04 ON flt04_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp01_company_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_cd = ( CASE #{transCode} WHEN '100' THEN ( CASE WHEN emp03_trans_cd <= '899' /** 퇴직(900)만 제외한다. (겸직자 재직자로 인식)-*/ THEN emp03_trans_cd ELSE #{transCode} END) WHEN '900' THEN '900' WHEN '800' THEN '800' ELSE emp03_trans_cd END)
AND COALESCE(flt03.account_cnt, 0) != 0
AND ( ( COALESCE(sys01_ics_non_stay_yn,'false') = 'false' AND /*비상근 제외*/ emp03_title_cd != '900' AND COALESCE(emp03_non_stay_yn,'false') != 'true' ) OR ( COALESCE(sys01_ics_non_stay_yn,'false') = 'true' ) ) /*비상근 포함*/ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp01_person_id ) /*겸직 제외*/ )
mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY emp01_kor_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc) AS tr_id , x.emp01_person_id AS person_id , x.emp01_kor_nm AS person_name , x.org02_kor_nm AS org_name , TO_CHAR(x.flt10_appr_effect_date::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS appr_effect_date FROM (select * , (select apr01_effect_date from flt03_account left outer join apr01_appr on flt03_appr_id = apr01_appr_id where flt03_person_id = flt02_person_id order by apr01_effect_date limit 1) AS flt10_appr_effect_date from emp where emp.flt02_check_cycle = '2') x WHERE flt10_appr_effect_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY emp01_kor_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY flt10_person_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc) AS tr_id , flt10_person_id AS person_id , flt10_person_nm AS person_name , flt10_org_nm AS org_name , flt10_check_cycle_nm AS check_cycle_name , flt10_tr_yn AS tr_yn , flt10_deposit_amt AS deposit_amt , flt10_total_invest_amt AS total_invest_amt , flt10_corp_nm AS corp_name , flt10_account_no AS account_no , flt10_account_nm AS account_name , flt10_tr_item_nm AS tr_item_name , flt10_tr_type_nm AS tr_type_name , TO_CHAR(flt10_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date , flt10_expect_tr_qty AS expect_tr_qty , TO_CHAR(flt10_tr_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_date , flt10_tr_qty AS tr_qty , flt10_unit_price AS unit_price , flt10_tr_amt AS tr_amt FROM (select emp.emp01_person_id AS flt10_person_id , emp.emp01_kor_nm AS flt10_person_nm , (select CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '' ELSE '매매없음' END from flt10_tr where flt10_person_id = emp.emp01_person_id and EXTRACT(YEAR FROM flt10_tr_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) and EXTRACT(MONTH FROM flt10_tr_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date))) AS flt10_tr_yn , (select COALESCE(SUM(flt10_tr_amt),0) from flt10_tr where flt10_tr_type = '50I' and flt10_person_id = emp.emp01_person_id and EXTRACT(YEAR FROM flt10_tr_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) and flt10_tr_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) AS flt10_deposit_amt , emp.org02_kor_nm AS flt10_org_nm , emp.emp01_total_invest_amt AS flt10_total_invest_amt , sys15_corp_nm AS flt10_corp_nm , TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) AS flt10_account_no , flt03_account_nm AS flt10_account_nm , flt10_tr_item_nm , f_cdnm('FloorTrCode', flt10_tr_type, flt10_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS flt10_tr_type_nm , flt10_reg_date , COALESCE(flt10_expect_tr_qty,0) AS flt10_expect_tr_qty , flt10_tr_date , COALESCE(flt10_tr_qty,0) AS flt10_tr_qty , COALESCE(flt10_tr_amt,0) AS flt10_tr_amt , CASE WHEN flt10_tr_qty > 0 THEN TRUNC(flt10_tr_amt / flt10_tr_qty) ELSE 0 END AS flt10_unit_price , emp.flt02_check_cycle AS flt10_check_cycle , f_cdnm('FloorTrCheckCycle', emp.flt02_check_cycle, emp01_company_id, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) AS flt10_check_cycle_nm from emp left outer join (select * from flt10_tr LEFT OUTER JOIN flt05_item_type flt05 ON ( flt05.flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05.flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_item_type AND flt05.flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_item_type AND flt05_start_date <= flt10_expect_tr_date ) ) left outer join flt03_account on flt03_account_id = flt10_account_id left outer join sys15_corp on sys15_corp_id = flt03_corp_id AND sys15_company_id = flt03_company_id where EXTRACT(YEAR FROM flt10_tr_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) and EXTRACT(MONTH FROM flt10_tr_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date))) flt10 ON flt10.flt10_person_id = emp.emp01_person_id where emp.flt02_check_cycle = '2' UNION ALL select emp.emp01_person_id AS flt10_person_id , emp.emp01_kor_nm AS flt10_person_nm , (select CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '' ELSE '매매없음' END from flt10_tr where flt10_person_id = emp.emp01_person_id and EXTRACT(YEAR FROM flt10_tr_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) and EXTRACT(MONTH FROM flt10_tr_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date))) AS flt10_tr_yn , (select COALESCE(SUM(flt10_tr_amt),0) from flt10_tr where flt10_tr_type = '50I' and flt10_person_id = emp.emp01_person_id and EXTRACT(YEAR FROM flt10_tr_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date))) AS flt10_deposit_amt , emp.org02_kor_nm AS flt10_org_nm , emp.emp01_total_invest_amt AS flt10_total_invest_amt , sys15_corp_nm AS flt10_corp_nm , TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) AS flt10_account_no , flt03_account_nm AS flt10_account_nm , flt10_tr_item_nm , f_cdnm('FloorTrCode', flt10_tr_type, flt10_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS flt10_tr_type_nm , flt10_reg_date , COALESCE(flt10_expect_tr_qty,0) AS flt10_expect_tr_qty , flt10_tr_date , COALESCE(flt10_tr_qty,0) AS flt10_tr_qty , COALESCE(flt10_tr_amt,0) AS flt10_tr_amt , CASE WHEN flt10_tr_qty > 0 THEN TRUNC(flt10_tr_amt / flt10_tr_qty) ELSE 0 END AS flt10_unit_price , emp.flt02_check_cycle AS flt10_check_cycle , f_cdnm('FloorTrCheckCycle', emp.flt02_check_cycle, emp01_company_id, CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) AS flt10_check_cycle_nm from emp left outer join (select * from flt10_tr LEFT OUTER JOIN flt05_item_type flt05 ON ( flt05.flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05.flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_item_type AND flt05.flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = flt10_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt10_item_type AND flt05_start_date <= flt10_expect_tr_date ) ) left outer join flt03_account on flt03_account_id = flt10_account_id left outer join sys15_corp on sys15_corp_id = flt03_corp_id AND sys15_company_id = flt03_company_id where EXTRACT(YEAR FROM flt10_tr_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) and EXTRACT(MONTH FROM flt10_tr_date) BETWEEN CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) WHEN 3 THEN 1 WHEN 6 THEN 4 WHEN 9 THEN 7 WHEN 12 THEN 10 ELSE 1 END and CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 6 THEN 6 WHEN 9 THEN 9 WHEN 12 THEN 12 ELSE 12 END) flt10 ON flt10.flt10_person_id = emp.emp01_person_id where emp.flt02_check_cycle = '1' and EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) IN (3, 6, 9, 12)) x ORDER BY flt10_person_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc

SELECT apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_status_cd AS status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, #{companyId}, f_sysdate()) AS status_name FROM apr01_appr WHERE apr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM apr01_effect_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM apr01_effect_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) AND apr01_class_tree_id IN ( SELECT dcr30_class_tree_id FROM dcr30_link WHERE dcr30_company_id = apr01_company_id AND dcr30_link_cd = #{linkCode} )
